per_candidate.id: s2:Atmospheric disequilibrium as an exoplanet biosignature : Opportunities for next
s2:The Exo-Life Finder (ELF) telescope: New strategies for direct detection of exop

rationale: The papers 'Disequilibrium biosignatures over Earth history and implications for detecting exoplanet life' (1801.08211) and 'When is chemical disequilibrium in Earth-like planetary atmospheres a biosignature versus an anti-biosignature?' (1911.06852) provide substantive new evidence regarding the nature of chemical disequilibrium as a biosignature, contributing to the understanding of the question.
